lines.text: A diamond mine began with a pun.
In 1955, geologists in Siberia found diamond bearing rock by a river.

They added that the tobacco was excellent.
The pipe was named Mir, which means peace.

post.caption: A diamond mine began with a pun. In 1955, geologists in Siberia found diamond bearing rock by a river. Reportedly, they radioed in code that they smoked a peace pipe. Kimberlite deposits are called pipes, so the code hid the news. They added that the tobacco was excellent. The pipe was named Mir, which means peace. A town called Mirny was built beside the pit for the miners. By the 1960s, it yielded about 10 million carats a year. The open pit closed in 2001, after 44 years of mining. The pit is 525 meters deep and 1,200 meters across. Photo: Vladimir, CC BY 3.0.
